description: Disturbing taglines surfaced in the lobby palace-subtitle when the child's average mood drops below 3. Higher disturbance = denser glitches, ghost overlays, letter-spacing bursts. Runtime source of truth is js/taglines.js — keep that in sync since the game runs from file:// and cannot fetch JSON.
